notes: ai.meta.com blocks both web readers (network error) — fetched via headless browser (Playwright) per README degradation path; page header prints 'July 23, 2024' (no machine-readable publishedTime meta). PROSE CONTAINS ZERO BENCHMARK NAMES OR SCORES: the 'Model evaluations' section says only 'evaluated performance on over 150 benchmark datasets' plus 'extensive human evaluations' vs GPT-4/GPT-4o/Claude 3.5 Sonnet. Both evaluation tables are fbcdn PNG images (signed expiring URLs — locators use section+row, not URLs): table 1 = 405B vs Nemotron 4 340B Instruct / GPT-4 (0125) / GPT-4o / Claude 3.5 Sonnet (15 rows recorded here as pending with visual-read values in notes); table 2 = Llama 3.1 8B & 70B vs Gemma 2 9B IT / Mistral 7B / Mixtral 8x22B / GPT-3.5 Turbo (NOT converted to rows — transcribed values for follow-up: 70B MMLU 86.0 / MMLU-Pro 66.4 / IFEval 87.5 / HumanEval 80.5 / MBPP 86.0 / GSM8K 95.1 / MATH 68.0 / ARC-C 94.8 / GPQA 0-shot 46.7 / BFCL 84.8 / ZeroSCROLLS 90.5 / InfiniteBench 78.2 / NIH 97.5 / MGSM 86.9; 8B values also in the transcription log). Distinct release from legacy/llama-3.json (Llama 3, 2024-04 — 15T tokens, 8B/70B only); 3.1 adds 405B + 128K context and is NOT a duplicate of that legacy entry. Shown table-2 GPQA is 0-shot while table-1 GPQA is 8-shot — different protocols recorded per row.
